		y = 53

		available = {
			western_social_democrats_are_in_power = yes
			OR = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SOV_power_democratic_socialists has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SOV_we_a_democratic_union }
		}

		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_POLITICAL }

		completion_reward = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Focus COLDWAR_SOV_uds_socialist_democracy"
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SOV_uds_programme } } } hidden_effect = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SOV_uds_programme } } }
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_SOV_uds_programme }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_uds_programme_democratic_drift = 0.02 tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_mod_democratic_drift_tt }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_uds_programme_stability_factor = -0.02 tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_mod_stability_factor_tt }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_uds_programme_research_speed_factor = 0.03 tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_mod_research_speed_factor_tt }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_uds_programme_consumer_goods_factor = -0.02 tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_mod_consumer_goods_factor_tt }
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
		}

		ai_will_do = {
			base = 3
			modifier = {
				factor = 0.1
				is_historical_focus_on = yes
			}
		}
	}
